title: DWP ‘cyber incident’ knocks almost all pensions and benefits systems offline
summary: Department for Work and Pensions officials say welfare payments will continue to be made despite huge outage

blocks.text:
Department for Work and Pensions officials say welfare payments will continue to be made despite huge outage

  • UK politics live – latest updates

Almost all pensions and benefits systems in the UK are unavailable following a “cyber incident”.

Anyone trying to check their state pension, make an application for disability benefits or claim universal credit was not able to do so on Friday morning. Department for Work and Pensions officials say payments will continue to be made as normal.
